scope: 英国大不列颠（GB）市场的通用广告/不公平商业行为、价格标示、消费者合同与商品说明、电气与产品安全/准入标识、无线电与电磁兼容、WEEE/电池标识、隐私告知与电子营销；品类聚焦小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码。北爱尔兰适用 EU 规则（CE/UKNI），本版仅标注差异，不单独建库。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在“法条原文 + 页面原文”同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.notes: 这是上位兜底条款，不单独凭词表下结论；具体类型见 misleading action / omission / aggressive / Schedule 20。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 面向英国消费者的商业行为不得构成“不公平商业行为”。判断以“平均消费者”是否会因此作出本来不会作的交易决定为准，覆盖推广与供应的全过程（含售后）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与上下文、投放渠道与时间、价格/库存/认证等可核事实、消费者沟通记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事：CMA 可调查并直接开罚单（见 UK-ADV-17）；刑事：部分情形构成犯罪（见 UK-ADV-15）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Unfair commercial practices are prohibited.

rules.notes: 认证类声称（CE/UKCA/“官方认证”）优先用本条 + Schedule 20 para 3/4/10 组合判断。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得就产品、商家或其他影响交易决定的事项提供虚假或误导性信息。含明示与暗示；与可核事实（认证、奖项、销量、材质）不符即落入本条。
rules.evidence_needed: 认证证书与查询链接、奖项/媒体原文、销量或测试数据、材质与规格书；与页面表述逐项对照。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事：可罚（UK-ADV-17）；刑事：故意或过失的误导行为可构成 s.237 罪，最高 2 年监禁（UK-ADV-15）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: For the purposes of this Chapter, a commercial practice involves a misleading action if the practice involves— (a) the provision of false or misleading information relating to a product, a trader or any other matter relevant to a transactional decision

rules.notes: 典型：小小字标注“from £19.99”而实际最低可购配置远高；划线价无真实历史。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 信息即使字面真实，若呈现方式（版式、字号、位置、上下文、比较基准）造成误导，仍属误导性行为；“字面真实”不是抗辩。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面截图（桌面 + 移动）、价格历史、比较基准说明、字体与位置测量。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 s.226；CMA 可直接处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the reference to misleading information includes a reference to information which, although true, is presented in a misleading way.

rules.notes: 只放在折叠区、脚注、需要点开“more”才能看到，通常不满足。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得遗漏“平均消费者作出知情交易决定所需要的重要信息”；以不清楚、不及时、消费者不易看到的方式提供信息，等同于遗漏。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面完整截图、折叠区/脚注内容、条款链接可达性、披露与主声称的距离与显著性。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事：可罚（UK-ADV-17）；刑事：可构成 s.237(2) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In this section, references to omitting information include providing information— (a) in a way that is unclear or untimely, or (b) in such a way that the consumer is unlikely to see it.

rules.notes: 英国“drip pricing”规则：到结算才出现的强制费用属高风险；可选附加服务另有规则。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: “购买邀请”必须披露总价：包含消费者购买时必然发生的费用、税费与收费；无法预先计算的，须说明计算方式，且显著度不得低于总价本身。
rules.evidence_needed: 结算页截图（含运费/税费出现时点）、商品页价格展示、配送与支付费用规则。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事：可罚（UK-ADV-17）；刑事：可构成 s.237(6) 罪（遗漏购买邀请中的重要信息）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: For the purposes of subsection (2)(b) the total price of a product includes any fees, taxes, charges or other payments that the consumer will necessarily incur if the consumer purchases the product.

rules.notes: 胁迫不限于人身威胁；“不退不换”“必须今天下单否则涨价”等需结合语境判断。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得使用骚扰、胁迫或不正当影响；判断看行为性质、时间地点、是否使用威胁性语言、是否利用消费者弱点、是否以不能依法采取的行动相威胁、是否要求消费者承担过重负担才能行使权利。
rules.evidence_needed: 客服话术、弹窗与倒计时、取消/退货流程截图、威胁性表述原文、消费者投诉记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事：可罚；刑事：可构成 s.237(3) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: For the purposes of this Chapter, a commercial practice involves an aggressive practice if it uses harassment, coercion or undue influence.

rules.notes: “CE”“UKCA”本身不是第三方认证标志，不得包装成“认证机构颁发”。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 未取得必要授权，不得展示信任标志、质量标志或同类标志。页面上的认证徽章必须能对应到真实、有效、覆盖该产品的授权。
rules.evidence_needed: 徽章原图与链接、发证机构查询结果、证书编号与有效期、授权范围是否覆盖该 SKU。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属“在任何情况下都不公平”的清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪（该条不在排除清单内）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Displaying a trust mark, quality mark or equivalent without having obtained the necessary authorisation.

rules.notes: “英国政府认证”“NHS 推荐”“Which? 推荐”等必须有可核来源。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得虚假声称商家、商业行为或产品获得公共/私人机构批准、背书或授权；即使曾获授权，若未遵守授权条件，同样落入本条。
rules.evidence_needed: 授权文件、背书方确认、合作期限与范围、授权条件履行记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Claiming that a trader, a trader's commercial practice, or a product has been approved, endorsed or authorised by a public or private body when— (a) the claim is false, or (b) the terms of the approval, endorsement or authorisation have not been, or are not being, complied with.

rules.notes: 页面本身通常无法证明“产品不能上市销售”；只能在有明确缺失（如无 UKCA/CE、无进口商信息）时作为“需核实”提示。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得声称或造成“产品可在英国市场销售”的印象，而实际不能。适用于缺少必要合规评估、标识或技术文件的电器/无线产品。
rules.evidence_needed: 符合性声明（DoC）、技术文件、测试报告、UKCA/CE 标识与进口商信息、主管机关查询结果。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Stating or otherwise creating the impression that a product can be legally sold when it cannot.

rules.notes: “精选好评”“只展示 5 星”也可能构成“以误导方式发布”（para 13(2) 及定义）。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得提交或委托提交虚假评论、隐瞒被激励事实的评论；不得以误导方式发布评论；并须采取合理、相称的措施防止和删除此类评论。
rules.evidence_needed: 评论来源与采集方式、激励记录、审核与删除流程、评论与订单的对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚。注意 s.237(8) 将 para 13 排除在刑事罪之外（仍属民事不公平行为）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Submitting, or commissioning another person to submit or write— (a) a fake consumer review, or (b) a consumer review that conceals the fact it has been incentivised.

rules.notes: “引流价”无货、只卖高价配置，是典型风险。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 以特定价格发出购买邀请时，若有合理理由相信无法在合理时间内、以合理数量按该价格供货（或安排他人供货），且未披露该事实，即属禁止行为。
rules.evidence_needed: 库存与补货记录、该价格的实际可售 SKU、促销期限、履约记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Making an invitation to purchase products at a specified price where— (a) the trader has reasonable grounds for believing that it will not be possible for the trader to offer those products, or equivalent products, for supply at that price, in reasonable quantities, for a reasonable period of time (or to procure another trader to do so), and (b) the trader does not disclose that fact.

rules.notes: 常驻倒计时、刷新即重置的“限时”是高风险信号。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得虚假声称产品仅在限时/特定条件下限时供应，以促使消费者立即决定、剥夺其知情选择的时间。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销排期、历史价格与活动记录、倒计时是否重置、活动是否真实结束。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Falsely stating that a product will only be available for a limited time, or that it will only be available on particular terms for a limited time, in order to elicit an immediate decision and deprive consumers of sufficient opportunity or time to make an informed choice.

rules.notes: “买一送一”“免费赠滤芯”需核对是否隐含必须购买或订阅。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 若消费者除回应商业行为及领取/支付配送费用外还需支付任何费用，不得将产品描述为“免费”“赠品”“不收费”或类似表述。
rules.evidence_needed: 赠品活动规则、是否需购买主商品、配送/包装/服务费、会员门槛。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Describing a product as "gratis", "free", "without charge" or similar if the consumer has to pay anything other than the unavoidable cost of responding to the commercial practice and collecting or paying for delivery of the item.

rules.notes: 空气净化器/蒸汽清洁器/美容仪的“杀菌、抗过敏、治疗”类表述是高风险区。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 不得虚假声称产品能够预防或治疗疾病、矫正畸形、恢复/纠正/改变生理功能或改变外貌。“disease”包括任何伤害、疾病或不良状况（身体或精神）。
rules.evidence_needed: 临床/微生物检测报告、测试标准与实验室资质、声称适用范围、是否属医疗器械（MHRA）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单行为；民事可罚；刑事：s.237(7) 罪。若构成医疗器械声称，另有 MHRA 准入问题。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Falsely claiming that a product is able to— (a) prevent or treat disease or a malformation, (b) restore, correct or modify a physiological function, or (c) modify a person's appearance.

rules.notes: Schedule 20 para 12/13/30 被排除在刑事罪之外（s.237(8)），但仍属民事不公平行为。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: 违反 s.225(1) 且涉及误导性行为、误导性遗漏、激进行为或购买邀请遗漏重要信息的，构成刑事犯罪；专业勤勉义务的违反需具备明知或轻率。
rules.evidence_needed: 同对应实体规则；另需保存广告版本、投放时间与决策记录（用于抗辩）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 简易程序：罚金（英格兰/威尔士）；苏格兰/北爱不超过法定上限。公诉程序：最高 2 年监禁或罚金（或并罚）。追诉期：行为发生后 3 年与检方发现后 1 年，取较早者（s.241）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A trader commits an offence if, in breach of section 225(1), the trader engages in an unfair commercial practice which involves a misleading action within section 226(1)(a), (b) or (c)

rules.notes: 与旧 CPRs 时代不同：CMA 现在可以主动要求 substantiation，而不是等法院。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: CMA 在程序中有权要求商家就商业行为中的事实性声称提供准确性证据；不提供或证据不足，CMA 可直接认定该声称不准确。
rules.evidence_needed: 测试报告、检测方法、样本与批次、第三方报告、数据来源与计算过程；须能在收到要求后合理期限内提交。
rules.penalty_or_note: 证据不足本身即可导致“声称不准确”的认定，并进而支撑处罚；无需另行证明主观虚假。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The CMA may determine that a factual claim of the respondent is inaccurate if— (a) the respondent fails to provide evidence of the accuracy of the claim in response to a requirement imposed under subsection (2), or (b) the CMA considers that any such evidence that is provided is inadequate.

rules.notes: 2025-04-06 起适用；这是英国消费者保护执法从“只能申请法院禁令”转向“可直接罚款”的关键变化。
rules.law_name: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 数字市场、竞争与消费者法 2024
rules.requirement: CMA 认定存在相关侵权后，可直接发出最终侵权通知并处罚款；罚款为固定金额，上限 £300,000 或（更高者）全球营业额 10%。
rules.evidence_needed: 营业额口径（集团/单体）、侵权持续时间、是否曾有承诺或前案。
rules.penalty_or_note: 固定金额上限 £300,000 或全球营业额 10%（取高者）；另可要求发布更正声明（s.182(8)）。违反承诺/指示另按 s.190（5% 营业额）计算。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The amount of a monetary penalty imposed under subsection (4)(b) must be a fixed amount not exceeding £300,000 or, if higher, 10% of the total value of the turnover (if any) of the respondent.

rules.notes: 面向英国消费者的独立站若只显示 USD/RMB，属页面可直接观察的缺口；跨境电商平台模式另论。
rules.law_name: Price Marking Order 2004 价格标示令 2004
rules.requirement: 向消费者标示销售价格（及适用的单位价格）时，必须以英镑表示。若同时接受外币，还须给出外币价格与佣金或明确换算率，并说明卡组织换算的例外。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面价格与币种、结算币种、是否按实时汇率换算、外币收费说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 由地方贸易标准部门执法；违反属刑事犯罪（经简易程序罚金）。实际执法以整改为主。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The indication of selling price and unit price shall be in sterling.

rules.notes: 这是合同条款而非广告规则；页面与实物不符时可直接引用。
rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 消费者权益法 2015
rules.requirement: 以描述方式供应商品的合同，视为包含“商品须与描述一致”的条款。页面描述、图片、规格、材质、型号均构成描述的一部分。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面描述与实物的对照、规格书、第三方检测、买家收到的实物照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: 消费者可主张修理/更换/减价/最终拒收（s.19-24）；商家不能以“图片仅供参考”排除（见 UK-DESC-04）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Every contract to supply goods by description is to be treated as including a term that the goods will match the description.

rules.notes: “主要特征”包括材质、规格、尺寸、功能、兼容性等；页面写了就算数。
rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 消费者权益法 2015
rules.requirement: 商家提供的、属于 2013 年消费者合同信息条例附表 1/2 (a) 项“商品主要特征”的信息，视为合同条款；事后单方变更无效，除非消费者明示同意。
rules.evidence_needed: 下单前的商品页快照、规格表、订单确认邮件、变更记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反视为违约；消费者可主张 s.19 救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any information that is provided by the trader about the goods and is information mentioned in paragraph (a) of Schedule 1 or 2 to the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 (SI 2013/3134) (main characteristics of goods) is to be treated as included as a term of the contract.

rules.notes: 与 s.9(6) 的例外（不知情、已撤回/更正、不可能影响决定）需商家举证。
rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 消费者权益法 2015
rules.requirement: 判断商品是否“令人满意”时，须考虑商家、生产商或其代表就商品特定特征所作的公开陈述，尤其包括广告或标签中的陈述。夸大的公开声称会抬高法定质量标准。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告与标签原文、发布时间、是否已公开撤回/更正、消费者是否可能受影响。
rules.penalty_or_note: 公开声称构成“相关情形”；消费者可据此主张不符合合同。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (5) The relevant circumstances mentioned in subsection (2)(c) include any public statement about the specific characteristics of the goods made by the trader, the producer or any representative of the trader or the producer. (6) That includes, in particular, any public statement made in advertising or labelling.

rules.notes: 常见于“清仓商品不退不换”“拆封不退”，与法定 14 天取消权/质量救济冲突。
rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 消费者权益法 2015
rules.requirement: 排除或限制商家在 s.9-17、s.28-29 下责任的合同条款，对消费者不具有约束力；“不退不换”“售出不负责”等表述不能对抗法定权利。
rules.evidence_needed: 条款原文与位置、结账流程中的勾选、售后政策页面。
rules.penalty_or_note: 条款不具约束力（不是“无效即免责”）；监管可依 CRA 附表 3 执法。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A term of a contract to supply goods is not binding on the consumer to the extent that it would exclude or restrict the trader's liability arising under any of these provisions— (a) section 9 (goods to be of satisfactory quality); (b) section 10 (goods to be fit for particular purpose); (c) section 11 (goods to be as described);

rules.notes: “随时单方变更”“最终解释权归商家”在英国属高风险表述。
rules.law_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 消费者权益法 2015
rules.requirement: 违反诚信要求、造成双方权利义务显著失衡并损害消费者的合同条款不公平，对消费者不具约束力；消费者通知同样适用。
rules.evidence_needed: 条款全文、缔约情境、同类市场惯例、对消费者的实际影响。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不公平条款不具约束力；CMA/贸易标准可执法。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A term is unfair if, contrary to the requirement of good faith, it causes a significant imbalance in the parties' rights and obligations under the contract to the detriment of the consumer.

rules.notes: 页面只能作为“声称”观察；不得仅凭页面缺失推断未认证。
rules.law_name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 电气设备（安全）条例 2016
rules.requirement: 制造商在投放市场前，必须确保电气设备按安全目标的主要要素设计与制造。页面声称合规，须能给出对应的符合性评估与测试证据。
rules.evidence_needed: 符合性声明（DoC）、按 BS EN 60335 系列的测试报告、技术文件、关键件清单（插头、保险丝、电源线）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪：简易程序最高 3 个月监禁/罚金；公诉程序最高 2 年监禁/罚金（reg 50-51）。市场监督可要求下架、召回。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Before placing electrical equipment on the market, a manufacturer must ensure that it has been designed and manufactured in accordance with the principal elements of the safety objectives.

rules.notes: 若页面/包装只有品牌名而无制造商邮政地址，属可观察缺口。
rules.law_name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 电气设备（安全）条例 2016
rules.requirement: 投放市场前，设备须带有型号、批次或序列号等可识别要素，并标注制造商名称/注册商标及可联系的单一邮政地址；无法标在产品上时，须标在包装或随附文件中。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品铭牌/包装照片、型号与批次、制造商名称与地址、进口商信息（如适用）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪（reg 50）；可被要求整改或下架。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (a) ensure that it bears a type, batch or serial number or other element allowing its identification

rules.notes: “easily understandable English”高于“有英文即可”；机翻痕迹明显的说明书是风险信号。
rules.law_name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 电气设备（安全）条例 2016
rules.requirement: 投放市场时，电气设备须随附清晰、易读且以“易于理解的英语”写成的说明与安全信息。仅提供中文/多语但无英文，不满足。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书 PDF/实物照片、语言版本、安全警示是否完整。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪（reg 50）；可被要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: When placing electrical equipment on the market, a manufacturer must ensure that it is accompanied by instructions and safety information that are clear, legible and in easily understandable English.

rules.notes: “UKCA certified by [importer]”属高风险：进口商/经销商不能自行“认证”。
rules.law_name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 电气设备（安全）条例 2016
rules.requirement: 非制造商不得加贴 UKCA 标志；且只有在已按附表 2 完成符合性评估程序后，制造商才可加贴。不得加贴可能误导他人对 UKCA 含义或形式的标志。
rules.evidence_needed: 标志位置照片、制造商身份、符合性评估记录、DoC。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪（reg 50）； improper use 是市场监督重点。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An economic operator must not affix the UK marking to electrical equipment unless— (a) that economic operator is the manufacturer; and (b) the conformity of the electrical equipment with the principal elements of the safety objectives has been demonstrated by the conformity assessment procedure set out in Schedule 2.

rules.notes: 向英国销售的小家电常见问题：发欧标插头 + 转换头，或插头无保险丝。
rules.law_name: Plugs and Sockets etc. (Safety) Regulations 1994 插头插座（安全）条例 1994
rules.requirement: 供应电器时，电器须正确装配符合 BS 1363 的标准插头，并配符合 BS 1362 且按制造商说明选型的保险丝；仅有欧标/美标插头或转换插头不满足（转换插头须为获批类型且需工具才能拆下）。
rules.evidence_needed: 插头实物照片（三脚、保险丝仓）、保险丝规格、转换插头型号与批准记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪；可被要求下架/召回。电气设备条例 reg 35 有对应的 GB 要求。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: no person shall supply, offer for supply, agree to supply, expose for supply or possess for supply any appliance unless that appliance is correctly fitted with a standard plug which– (a) complies with the requirements of regulation 8 above; and (b) is fitted with a fuse link which conforms to BS 1362 and is rated in accordance with the appliance manufacturer's instructions

rules.notes: GPSR 适用于非电气家居用品；电气产品同时受 EESR 约束。
rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulations 2005 通用产品安全条例 2005
rules.requirement: 生产者不得将非“安全产品”投放市场。安全产品指在正常或合理可预见使用条件下不构成风险（或仅构成与产品使用相容的最低风险）的产品。
rules.evidence_needed: 风险评估、测试报告、警示与说明、事故/投诉记录、可追溯信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg 5：公诉程序最高 12 个月监禁或 £20,000 罚金（或并罚）；简易程序最高 3 个月/法定上限罚金。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No producer shall place a product on the market unless the product is a safe product.

rules.notes: 警示存在不免除其他合规义务（reg 7(2)）。
rules.law_name: General Product Safety Regulations 2005 通用产品安全条例 2005
rules.requirement: 生产者须在合理范围内向消费者提供相关信息，使其能评估产品在正常/合理可预见使用期内的固有风险（风险非经适当警示不能立即明显时），并采取预防措施。
rules.evidence_needed: 警示标签与说明书、目标用户与使用场景、风险清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg 7(1)：简易程序最高 3 个月监禁或 level 5 罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Within the limits of his activities, a producer shall provide consumers with the relevant information to enable them— (a) to assess the risks inherent in a product throughout the normal or reasonably foreseeable period of its use, where such risks are not immediately obvious without adequate warnings, and (b) to take precautions against those risks.

rules.notes: 带电机/开关电源的小家电与带无线模块的 3C 都需 EMC；无线另受 Radio Equipment Regulations 2017。
rules.law_name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016 电磁兼容条例 2016
rules.requirement: 设备不符合电磁兼容“基本要求”的，不得投放市场或投入使用。页面声称 EMC 合规，须有对应测试与 DoC。
rules.evidence_needed: EMC 测试报告（BS EN 55014 / 61000 系列）、DoC、技术文件。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪（reg 61-62）；可被要求下架。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A person must not make equipment available on the market or put equipment into service unless it complies with the essential requirements.

rules.notes: 蓝牙/Wi-Fi 产品若只给中文说明书或未标频段/功率，属可观察缺口。
rules.law_name: Radio Equipment Regulations 2017 无线电设备条例 2017
rules.requirement: 无线电设备须随附清晰、易读、易于理解的英文说明与安全信息，包含按预期用途使用所需信息；可有意发射无线电波的设备还须说明频段与最大射频功率。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书、频段与功率参数、DoC、测试报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪；可被要求整改/下架。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: When placing radio equipment on the market, a manufacturer must ensure that radio equipment is accompanied with instructions and safety information which— (a) are clear, legible and in easily understandable English, (b) include information required to use the radio equipment in accordance with its intended use

rules.notes: 页面通常看不到产品本体符号；以包装/说明书照片为证据时标注“需商家提供”。
rules.law_name: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 废弃电子电气设备条例 2013
rules.requirement: 生产者或其授权代表须在投放市场的 EEE 上标注附表 6 的“打叉带轮垃圾桶”符号；尺寸/功能所限时可印在包装、说明书与随附保修文件上。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品/包装照片、符号位置与清晰度、生产者注册号（如页面展示）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪；可被要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Subject to the application of regulation 24A, a producer or authorised representative must mark EEE that he places on the market with the symbol shown in Schedule 6 ("the crossed out wheeled bin symbol").

rules.notes: 含内置锂电池的小家电需同时满足 WEEE 与电池标识。
rules.law_name: Batteries and Accumulators (Placing on the Market) Regulations 2008 电池及蓄电池（投放市场）条例 2008
rules.requirement: 电池或电池组投放市场前，须标注附表 1 的“打叉带轮垃圾桶”符号；尺寸过小时可改印在包装上（至少 1×1 cm）。
rules.evidence_needed: 电池/包装照片、符号尺寸、是否含汞/镉/铅及对应化学符号（reg 6）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪（reg 15-16）；可被要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall place on the market any battery or battery pack unless it is marked with the symbol shown in Schedule 1 (the "crossed out wheeled bin symbol").

rules.notes: 北爱尔兰适用 EU 规则（CE/UKNI），与 GB 不同；页面若同时面向 NI 需分别说明。
rules.law_name: Placing UKCA or CE marked products on the market in Great Britain (gov.uk guidance) 英国 GB 市场 UKCA/CE 标识指引
rules.requirement: 在 GB 市场，CE 标志在《2024 年产品安全与计量（修订）条例》下继续与 UKCA 并行被承认；商家可选择其一，但必须完成对应法规的符合性评估并保存技术文件。声称“必须 UKCA、CE 已失效”属过时信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 所用标志路径（UKCA 或 CE）、对应法规、DoC、技术文件、进口商信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 指引本身不设罚则；不符合对应产品法规即属违反法定义务（如 EESR reg 50）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the UK continues to recognise the CE marking, alongside or in place of the UKCA marking, for the Great Britain market under The Product Safety and Metrology (Amendment) Regulations 2024

rules.notes: 英国 GDPR 已经《2025 年数据（使用与访问）法》修订；引文以 legislation.gov.uk 现行合并文本为准。
rules.law_name: UK General Data Protection Regulation 英国通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 从数据主体收集个人数据时，须在收集时提供：控制者身份与联系方式、DPO 联系方式（如适用）、处理目的与法律依据、正当利益（如适用）、接收方类别、跨境传输与保障措施等信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策全文、收集点（表单/结账/客服）、Cookie 与第三方脚本清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICO 可罚款（英国 GDPR 上限 £17.5m 或全球营业额 4%，取高者）；另可被要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject, the controller shall, at the time when personal data are obtained, provide the data subject with all of the following information:

rules.notes: 与 Art 13 配套：Art 13 管“说什么”，Art 12 管“怎么说”。
rules.law_name: UK General Data Protection Regulation 英国通用数据保护条例
rules.requirement: 隐私信息须以简明、透明、易懂且易于获取的形式、用清晰平实的语言提供；不得用冗长法律术语掩盖关键信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策可读性（句长、术语）、层级与导航、移动端可读性。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 UK GDPR 罚则；透明度不足是 ICO 常见整改项。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The controller shall take appropriate measures to provide any information referred to in Articles 13 and 14 and any communication made under or by virtue of Articles 15 to 22D and 34 relating to processing to the data subject in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language, in particular for any information addressed specifically to a child.

rules.notes: “继续浏览即视为同意”、预勾选非必要 Cookie 通常不满足；拒绝应与接受同等容易。
rules.law_name: Privacy and Electronic Communications (EC Directive) Regulations 2003 隐私与电子通信条例 2003
rules.requirement: 除附表 A1 的例外，不得在用户终端设备存储信息或访问已存储信息（含 Cookie、像素、本地存储），除非已取得同意或属严格必要。
rules.evidence_needed: Cookie 横幅截图、默认开关状态、拒绝路径、第三方脚本清单与触发时点。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICO 可罚款（PECR 上限 £500,000）；亦可要求整改。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Subject to Schedule A1, a person must not store information, or gain access to information stored, in the terminal equipment of a subscriber or user.

rules.notes: 结账页预勾选“接收优惠邮件”是典型缺口；软 opt-in 不适用于新客获取。
rules.law_name: Privacy and Electronic Communications (EC Directive) Regulations 2003 隐私与电子通信条例 2003
rules.requirement: 向个人订阅者发送未经请求的直销电子邮件，须事先取得收件人同意；仅有“软 opt-in”（既有客户、同类产品、初始收集时已提供免费拒绝方式）为例外。
rules.evidence_needed: 订阅流程截图（是否预勾选）、同意记录（时间、来源、IP）、退订机制。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICO 可罚款（PECR 上限 £500,000）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: a person shall neither transmit, nor instigate the transmission of, unsolicited communications for the purposes of direct marketing by means of electronic mail unless the recipient of the electronic mail has previously notified the sender that he consents for the time being to such communications being sent by, or at the instigation of, the sender.

rules.notes: B2B 与 B2C 规则并行：批发/代工页面适用 BPRs，消费者页面适用 DMCCA。
rules.law_name: Business Protection from Misleading Marketing Regulations 2008 商业保护（禁止误导性营销）条例 2008
rules.requirement: 面向交易商（B2B）的广告不得误导：包括呈现方式使人误信，且可能影响其经济行为或损害竞争者。判断考虑产品特征、价格、供应条件、广告主属性等全部要素。
rules.evidence_needed: B2B 页面/展会物料原文、报价与供应条件、产能与资质证明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪：简易程序罚金不超过法定上限；可申请禁令（reg 15）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Advertising which is misleading is prohibited.

rules.notes: “vs 传统机型”类比较若无可核实测试，属 substantiation 缺口。
rules.law_name: Business Protection from Misleading Marketing Regulations 2008 商业保护（禁止误导性营销）条例 2008
rules.requirement: 比较广告仅在满足全部条件时允许：不误导、比较同类需求/用途的产品、就一项或多项重要、相关、可核实且具代表性的特征作客观比较，且不造成混淆、不贬损、不搭便车。
rules.evidence_needed: 比较基准与测试方法、对比机型、数据可复现性、商标使用授权。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反属犯罪；竞争者亦可申请禁令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: it objectively compares one or more material, relevant, verifiable and representative features of those products, which may include price

rules.notes: CAP 是行业自律守则，不是法条；但 ASA 裁决与 DMCCA 的判断标准已对齐。
rules.law_name: UK Code of Non-broadcast Advertising and Direct & Promotional Marketing (CAP Code) 英国非广播广告守则
rules.requirement: 在发布前，广告主须持有书面证据，证明消费者可能视为客观且可被客观证实的主张；缺乏充分证据时，ASA 可认定该主张误导。
rules.evidence_needed: 检测报告、试验数据、第三方认证、奖项原件；证据须在广告发布前已存在。
rules.penalty_or_note: ASA 可要求撤稿/整改并公布裁决；不移除可转介贸易标准（进而适用 DMCCA 罚则）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Before distributing or submitting a marketing communication for publication, marketers must hold documentary evidence to prove claims that consumers are likely to regard as objective and that are capable of objective substantiation.

rules.notes: “环保”“可持续”“零碳”是英国 2025-2026 执法重点；CMA Green Claims Code 亦适用。
rules.law_name: UK Code of Non-broadcast Advertising and Direct & Promotional Marketing (CAP Code) 英国非广播广告守则
rules.requirement: 环境声称的依据必须清晰；未加限定的声称若遗漏重要信息可构成误导。声称须基于产品完整生命周期，除非明确说明范围；绝对化声称须有高水平证据。
rules.evidence_needed: LCA 报告、测试标准、适用范围（部件/阶段）、抵消机制证明、比较基准。
rules.penalty_or_note: ASA 裁决与撤稿要求；严重/持续不合规可转介贸易标准。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The basis of environmental claims must be clear. Unqualified claims could mislead if they omit material information.
